title: Pseudo-isotopies of 3-manifolds with infinite fundamental groups
summary: Suppose $Y$ is a compact, connected, oriented 3-manifold possibly with boundary, such that $π_1(Y)$ is infinite. Let $\operatorname{Diff}_\partial(I\times Y)$ denote the group of self-diffeomorphisms of $I\times Y$ that are equal to the identity near the boundary. Let $\operatorname{Diff}_{PI}(I\times Y)$ denote the subgroup of $\operatorname{Diff}_\partial(I\times Y)$ consisting of elements pseudo-isotopic to the identity.
